ChangeAccessPassword.password: Password must be 8-16 characters long and contain at least two of the following: letters, numbers, and special characters. Allowed special characters include $^\*\(\)\_\+\-=. The password must be transmitted encrypted, plaintext transmission is prohibited. For details, please refer to [Password Encryption Transmission Specification](SCS/API参考/通用说明.md#密码加密传输规范定义)
